checks.title: Apache version is reported (inventory)
checks.rationale: Track major.minor version against your support policy.
checks.remediation: Stay on 2.4.x current; consider EOL of 2.2 if still in use.

checks.title: ServerTokens is set to Prod (minimal version disclosure)
checks.rationale: Full server tokens disclose OS and module version, aiding attacker fingerprinting.
checks.remediation: Set 'ServerTokens Prod' in the main config.

checks.title: ServerSignature is Off
checks.rationale: Server signature on error pages discloses Apache version.
checks.remediation: Set 'ServerSignature Off' in the main config.

checks.title: TraceEnable is Off
checks.rationale: TRACE/TRACK requests can be abused for XST and cookie disclosure.

checks.title: SSL protocols exclude TLS 1.0/1.1 and SSL 2/3
checks.rationale: Legacy TLS/SSL protocols are deprecated and broken.

checks.title: Directory listings are disabled (Options -Indexes)
checks.rationale: Open directory listings disclose application file layout.
checks.remediation: Use 'Options -Indexes' in <Directory> blocks (or remove the Indexes token).

checks.title: AllowOverride None is set on the document root
checks.audit: Inspect <Directory '/var/www/html'> blocks (or your DocumentRoot). Confirm 'AllowOverride None' to prevent .htaccess overriding the central policy.
checks.rationale: .htaccess can override security directives if AllowOverride is permissive.
checks.remediation: Set 'AllowOverride None' in the DocumentRoot's <Directory> block and reload.

checks.title: X-Frame-Options header configured
checks.remediation: Add 'Header always set X-Frame-Options DENY' to the main config.

checks.title: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header configured
checks.rationale: HSTS forces browsers to use HTTPS only, preventing protocol downgrade.

checks.title: Manual: confirm mod_security (WAF) or ModSecurity-CRS is enabled
checks.audit: Run 'apachectl -M' and confirm 'security2_module' is enabled. Inspect modsecurity.conf for OWASP CRS inclusion.
checks.rationale: A baseline WAF blocks generic injection / scanner traffic.
checks.remediation: Install libapache2-mod-security2 (or mod_security_crs), then enable + tune the OWASP Core Rule Set.
